answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own tide record, and its own share of the pearl quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The ripple ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 4089 identities would post 4356 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
